name: Edge Case — Unexpected User Input
goal: Bot ignores irrelevant user input and waits for a valid option selection.
constraints: Employee details are valid. User inputs an unrecognized message (e.g., 'banana') instead of selecting an option.

phases.description: Bot fetches and displays employee details.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays employee details and presents options.
Bot does not proceed and continues to wait for a valid option selection.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
